info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package cyber mounts Hanzo Cyber's native cloud control plane at /v1/cyber/*.

kaiRationale.description: KaiRationale explains why Kai assigned the risk score and required review.

status.description: Status is pending, approved, denied, or always_allow.

tool.description: Tool names the OpenCyber MCP tool or module requesting execution.

techniques.description: Techniques lists observed ATT&CK techniques ranked by severity.

verifiedCount.description: VerifiedCount is the number of verbatim-verified findings mapped here.

effort.description: Effort estimates implementation complexity (low, medium, high).

findingIds.description: FindingIDs lists finding identifiers closed by this action.

id.description: ID identifies the course of action.

mitreTechnique.description: MitreTechnique names the ATT&CK technique mitigated.

priority.description: Priority is P0, P1, P2, or P3.

summary.description: Summary describes the concrete operational change.

name.description: Name is the engagement display name.

scope.description: Scope enumerates authorized targets within Rules of Engagement.

target.description: Target is the primary system or enclave host under test.

evidenceQuote.description: EvidenceQuote is the exact proof substring to verify against traffic.

severity.description: Severity is critical, high, medium, low, or info.

target.description: Target names the affected host or endpoint.

action.description: Action is allow, block, require_approval, or tag.

goal.description: Goal states the desired verification outcome.

critical.description: Critical is the count of critical-severity findings.

low.description: Low is the count of low-severity findings.

medium.description: Medium is the count of medium-severity findings.

org.description: Org is the authenticated caller organization.

rulesCount.description: RulesCount is the number of active scope and intercept governance rules.

stage.description: Stage marks the release stage of Hanzo Cyber.

tasks.description: Tasks is the number of cyber tasks across the selected scope.

trafficCount.description: TrafficCount is the number of captured HTTP exchanges available for proof binding.

verificationRate.description: VerificationRate is the percentage (0-100) of findings verified verbatim against traffic.

decision.description: Decision must be approved, denied, or always_allow.

id.description: ID is the approval identifier from the URL path.

deleted.description: Deleted is true when the record was removed.

id.description: ID is the deleted record identifier.

data.description: Data holds the engagements ordered newest first.

mode.description: Mode describes the execution posture (enclave, cloud, hybrid, airgap).

name.description: Name is the human-readable engagement title.

scope.description: Scope lists authorized hostnames, CIDRs, or environments.

status.description: Status is the engagement lifecycle state (active, paused, completed).

synthetic.description: Synthetic marks lab/demonstration engagements using synthetic targets.

status.description: Status is open, verified, remediated, or false_positive.

tool.description: Tool names the tool requesting execution.

code.description: A stable token a client can branch on, when the refusal names one.

detail.description: What was refused, for a person to read.

bearer.description: The caller's credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is either an access token minted by Hanzo IAM or an API key (pk-/sk-). X-Authorization, and HTTP Basic carrying the token as the password, are accepted spellings of the same header for clients that cannot set Authorization; a browser presents the session cookie instead. Every operation requires it unless it says `security: []`.
